nodes.description: Address stored in BotProtected; set to tx.origin in BNVToken constructor and used as the sole privileged account.
External contract address invoked by the checkBots modifier and by distribute/list via low-level call.
Uniswap pair address computed in the constructor and forwarded to the bot protection contract.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated directly with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, distribute and list.
Public nested allowance mapping, written in approve/transferFrom and pre-seeded with uint(-1) in the constructor.
Public total supply, initially zero and never minted; used to derive the owner share in list.
Hardcoded UniswapV2 router interface used for the addLiquidityETH call in list.
Hardcoded WETH address used to derive the pair in the constructor.
BNVToken constructor: assigns owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, and grants infinite allowances.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Public payable transfer with the checkBots modifier; performs allowance check, unchecked balance updates and emits Transfer.
Public payable allowance setter that unconditionally overwrites the caller's allowance.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall payload supplied by the caller.
Internal pure function that deterministically derives a Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 hashing.
Owner-only function that calls the bot protection contract then overwrites balances of a supplied address array.
Owner-only payable function that moves balances, adds ETH liquidity through the router with a block.timestamp deadline, then distributes tokens.
BotProtected modifier performing an external low-level call to botProtection and requiring success before the function body runs.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance logic, owner checks and balance/allowance writes.
Origin address used to set owner and to seed the uniPair allowance in the constructor.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list.
Low-level botProtection.call with selector 0x15274141 executed inside the checkBots modifier before any state update.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied target address, executing arbitrary code in the token's storage context.
External value-bearing call to pancakeRouter.addLiquidityETH made inside list.
Raw Solidity 0.7 balance decrement/increment and allowance subtraction without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Low-level botProtection.call with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 in distribute and list, executed around balance mutation loops.
Unchecked multiplication/division (totalSupply * 6 / 100) used to compute the owner's balance in list.
Constructor parameter carrying the external bot protection address.
transferFrom source address parameter.
transferFrom destination address parameter.
transferFrom amount parameter.
approve spender address parameter.
Array of recipient addresses passed to distribute and list.
Array of amounts paired with _toAddresses in list.
Liquidity/balance amount parameter of list.
Delegatecall target address parameter of delegate.
Delegatecall calldata payload parameter of delegate.
Loop counter used in the distribution loops of distribute and list.
Amount parameter of distribute applied to every recipient.
First token address parameter of pairForUniswap.
Second token address parameter of pairForUniswap.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection flows into the constructor body.
Constructor parameter is written into the botProtection state variable.
tx.origin is read during construction to seed privileged state.
Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, delegating authorization to an origin address.
Constructor grants allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1), an origin-based privilege.
Constructor stores the computed pair into uniPair.
Constructor uses the hardcoded router address to seed its infinite allowance.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the source address to transferFrom.
transfer invokes transferFrom to perform the actual state change.
_from parameter drives allowance and balance lookups in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credit side of the balance update in transferFrom.
_value parameter controls allowance deduction and balance mutation.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether the allowance path is taken.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates user balances in the balanceOf mapping.
Unchecked subtraction/addition on balances and allowances is performed inside transferFrom.
The checkBots modifier gates and wraps the transferFrom body with an external call.
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level call to botProtection.
External call to botProtection happens before any balance/allowance update in transferFrom, enabling reentrant state observation.
botProtection state variable is the destination of the low-level call.
uniPair is passed as an argument in the bot protection call payload.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender as the owner.
_spender parameter is the key written in the allowance mapping.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the raw calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
delegate executes arbitrary code at a caller-supplied address in the contract's storage context.
require(msg.sender == owner) is the only guard on the delegatecall entry point.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender for authorization in delegate.
tokenA parameter participates in the deterministic pair hash computation.
tokenB parameter participates in the deterministic pair hash computation.
distribute is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner state variable is checked to authorize distribute.
_toAddresses array determines which balances are arbitrarily overwritten.
amount parameter is written into every recipient balance.
distribute overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
Low-level botProtection call in distribute runs before the balance assignment loop.
list is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
owner state variable is checked to authorize list.
_numList parameter sets the contract balance and the liquidity token amount.
_toAddresses array is iterated to assign balances in list.
_amounts array supplies the values written into recipient balances.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the router deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
External addLiquidityETH call is made mid-execution before the final distribution loop.
list writes directly into the balanceOf mapping.
pancakeRouter state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
Unchecked totalSupply * 6 / 100 computation determines the owner balance in list.
Loop counter i drives the balance assignment loop in distribute.
Loop counter i drives the balance assignment loop in list.
totalSupply is read to derive the owner's share in list.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is only meaningful as input to the constructor; fold it into the constructor node.
_from is a transferFrom parameter; fold it into the transferFrom function node.
_to is a transferFrom parameter; fold it into the transferFrom function node.
_value is a transferFrom parameter; fold it into the transferFrom function node.
_spender is an approve parameter; fold it into the approve function node.
_toAddresses is the recipient array of distribute; fold it into the distribute function node.
_amounts is only used by list; fold it into the list function node.
_numList is only used by list; fold it into the list function node.
Delegatecall target parameter a; fold it into the delegate function node.
Delegatecall payload parameter b; fold it into the delegate function node.
Loop counter i is a transient local of the distribution loops; fold it into the list function node.
amount parameter is applied to every recipient in distribute; fold it into the distribute function node.
tokenA is a pairForUniswap parameter; fold it into the pairForUniswap function node.
tokenB is a pairForUniswap parameter; fold it into the pairForUniswap function node.
